text:
sarah: heads-up — security triage: we got a CVE flagged in tokenizers wheels (manylinux wheel supplychain). I tried a `poetry lock` regen and it caused a bunch of CI wheel/test failures. need quick patch plan, minimal blast radius :grimacing:

mike: saw it in CI too. failures in the linux/macos wheel install step, error was linking `libc++` and wheel tag mismatch. quick log:```ERROR: Could not build wheels for tokenizers which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly```

alex: quick thought: keep the lockfile stable for now. surgical approach: pin tokenizers to the patched wheel version (from PyPI or our internal mirror) + add a `constraints.txt` so pip/ci uses the correct wheel. avoid full `poetry update` unless we have to.

jen: do we have a patched wheel published already? I can push to our internal dev-repo if needed.

sarah: priority = P1 (security) but want to avoid broad dependency churn. customers are on hosted api so we should be careful with major regen.

mike: test matrix shows failures mostly on 3.9 and on musllinux in the alpine image. 3.10 also flakey. pinpoint looks like manylinux tag change in tokenizers wheel.

alex: proposed steps:
1) open PR that pins `tokenizers==0.13.3` (or patched) in pyproject (no workspace-wide update)
2) add `constraints.txt` with wheel hashes for CI/docker builds
3) run CI, if green merge to main and branch-protect
4) create a backport PR to `release/1.x` branch (hotfix)
5) monitor canary environments and then promote

jen: ok i will open the pin+constraints PR. will attach CI logs.

sarah: also coordinate with Support for a customer note (no immediate mitigation required from customers, just FYI). add a short line to security-notices channel after merge.

mike: small gotcha: fastapi/starlette minor bumps are safe, but a naive `poetry update` pulled fastapi->0.95 and broke one test that relies on a private param in our infra. so do NOT update fastapi unless necessary. pin only tokenizers and related transitive deps.

alex: sample commands I'm going to put in the PR description:
```bash
# pin without updating everything
poetry add tokenizers==0.13.3 --lock
# or modify pyproject and regenerate lock for the specific package
poetry lock --no-update
# create constraints for pip-based installs (CI/Docker)
pip-compile --output-file constraints.txt pyproject.toml || echo "manual constraints created"
```

ci-bot: CI job 9821 failed: wheel-install step -> see logs https://ci.internal/9821

deploy-bot: created issue #452 in security-triage (tokenizers wheel CVE + CI failures)

jen: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/1789 — pins tokenizers + adds constraints, includes logs and a small test matrix run.

sarah: timeline: aim to merge after green on the constrained CI (no flaky jobs) — target 48h patch window. mike + alex will review. jen will backport after main merge.

mike: i'll watch the release pipeline and be ready to trigger hotfix build for dedicated images if green.

alex: one more note: add a short `security` label on the PR and set the changelog entry to `patch(security): tokenizers wheel CVE fix` so release notes pick it up.

jen: tagging @security for visibility on final merge.

sarah: thanks everyone. keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
